d:
Shravana Maasa Bandaga Is An Evergreen Kannada Lyrical Song From The Classic Movie Shravana Banthu, Featuring The Legendary Dr. Rajkumar And Urvashi. The Melodious Music Is Composed By Renowned Music Director M. Ranga Rao.
Enjoy The Nostalgic Beauty Of Shravana Maasa Bandaga And Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema. A Timeless Classic For Fans Of Dr. Rajkumar Songs, Urvashi Songs, Old Kannada Songs And Evergreen Kannada Melodies.
Directed by: Singeetham Srinivasa Rao
Produced by: Kameshwara Rao
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Urvashi, Srinath, K. S. Ashwath, Leelavathi
Music Director: M. Ranga Rao
